question: Where is the headquarters of the Spices Board of India located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kochi (Kerala)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kochi (Kerala)**, as it is the headquarters of the Spices Board of India.
 
• The Spices Board of India is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, responsible for the development and promotion of the Indian spices industry.
 
• Kochi, also known as Cochin, is a major port city in the southwestern state of Kerala and is known for its spice trade for centuries. The city has a long history of spice trading and is still one of the major spice markets in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bengaluru (Karnataka) **is a major IT hub and is known for its software industry.
 
• **Pune (Maharashtra)** is a major industrial city and is known for its manufacturing and automobile industry.
 
• **Guntur (Andhra Pradesh)** is known for its chilli production and is one of the major chilli markets in India.
 
• It is important to note that the Spices Board of India has regional offices in various cities across India, including Bengaluru, Pune, and Guntur, but the headquarters is located in Kochi, Kerala.
